# Plan: Marketing landing page

## Context

Source plan: `PLAN.md` (seed commit c2e0324). This file is the plan-mode plan
produced by `/plan-design-review`. It starts as a faithful copy of the supplied
requirements. Design gaps found during review are recorded below as PENDING
until the user approves each fix individually. Nothing in the "Approved
implementation" section changes until that approval lands.

Product scope is preserved as supplied: a single marketing landing page.
No DESIGN.md exists in this repo, so recommendations calibrate against
universal design principles, not a project design system.

## Supplied requirements (verbatim from PLAN.md)

### Layout
All headings, taglines, and body copy will be center-aligned for a
"clean modern look." The hero h1 sits 8px above the subhead with no
breathing room; the CTA button is the same visual weight as a
secondary "Learn more" link directly beside it.

## Approved implementation

"Pending design decisions" only after an explicit per-issue approval.)_
